simple.meaning: שְׁכָבָה (shᵉkâbâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a lying down (of dew, or for the sexual act).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 9 times in Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, beginning at Exodus 16:13. The surrounding contexts include Torah, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁכָבָה (H7902) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שְׁכָבָה (shᵉkâbâh) / H7902 is traced through Exodus 16:13, Exodus 16:14, Leviticus 15:16, Leviticus 15:17 with source-language evidence and verse context.

majorEvents.label: Defilement
majorEvents.evidenceText: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;

timeline.evidenceText: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.
When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.
“ ‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.
Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.
If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.
This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;

“ ‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

“ ‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,
and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;

definitions.short: a lying down (of dew, or for the sexual act)
definitions.full: H7902. shekabah [ שְׁכָבָה ] noun feminine act of lying, layer ; — only construct שִׁכְבַת all P; — 1 act of lying , as accusative of congnate meaning with verb with שׁכב 3: שִׁכְבַתזָֿ֑רַע Lev 15:18 a man lies with her a lying of seed (in copulation), compare 19:20 ; Num 5:13 ; then ( = semen ), שִׁכְבַתזָֿ֑רַע תֵּצֵא Lev 15:16 , 32 ; 22:4 (+ מִמֶּנּוּ ), ׳שׁ ׳ז alone 15:17 . 2 layer of dew, הַטָּ֑ל שִׁכְבַת Exod 16:13-14 , (P).
